title: Clearing commands name the wrong verb: settle for finding holds, 'findings' (list) for the finding wait, run-epic for cloud failures
body: statusmodel/build.go:761-775 emits 'ticfac settle ... --release' for every run_held line whatever the reason (finding_untriaged is cleared by ticfac triage); build.go:834 names 'ticfac findings <epic>', which only lists; overview.go:228,247 and build.go:755 name 'ticfac run-epic <epic>', which for a cloud run restarts it locally in the foreground instead of 'ticfac run <epic> --cloud'. watch.go:317 prints a literal <epic-id> placeholder. Merge waits and cancelled runs name no command.
